title: Task
description: A task as every tool returns it. Fields may be added; none are removed or retyped within a major version.

ref.description: The user's task number (#42); missing only on tasks from before 0.3.0 that were not migrated

dueDate.description: Due day in the user's time zone

from.description: Next date counted from the due date (default) or from the day the task was completed

monthDay.description: Monthly rules: day 1-31 (a shorter month's last day when it lacks the day) or -1 for the last day

nth.description: 1-5, or -1 (last) to -5 counted from the month's end

weekdayOfMonth.description: Monthly rules: e.g. the 2nd Tuesday or the last Friday

until.description: Last date the series may fall on

rrule.description: The repeat rule as an RFC 5545 RRULE value, e.g. FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,TH; only on repeating tasks

projectId.description: Id of the task's project (since 0.13.0); missing when it is in none

checklist.description: Checklist items in order; missing when the task has none

reminders.description: This task's own reminders; missing = the default reminders from settings, [] = none

minutesBefore.description: Minutes before the due time (timed tasks only)

daysBefore.description: Days before the due day; missing = on the due day

acceptance.description: Acceptance criteria in order: what done means; missing when the task has none. An agent can complete the task only when every criterion is met (since 0.10.0)

plan.description: How the work will be done (since 0.10.0)

dependsOn.description: Ids of the tasks that must be done first; missing when there are none (since 0.10.0)

blockedReason.description: Why the task cannot go on; a blocked task is not ready (since 0.10.0)

claimedBy.description: Who claimed the task (claim_task): an API key or an agent connection and its name. Kept after the claim expires until it is released or claimed again; compare claimExpiresAt with the time (since 0.10.0)

keyId.description: The API key holding the claim

connectionId.description: The agent connection (OAuth) holding the claim

name.description: The key's or the client's name, as history shows it

claimExpiresAt.description: When the claim ends, Unix time in milliseconds; in the past = expired, the task can be claimed again (since 0.10.0)

proposedAt.description: Set while the task is a proposal waiting in the owner's inbox (add_task with proposal: true), Unix time in milliseconds; it stays out of Today, the board, list_all and the calendar until accepted (since 0.11.0)

source.description: Where the task came from outside Dayhand; one source makes at most one task (since 0.11.0)

kind.description: The kind of source, e.g. sentry, github-issue, email

ref.description: The item's id in that source

requestedBy.description: Who asked for the task: as given by the caller, or the agent that added it (since 0.11.0)

returnTo.description: Webhooks that get task.returned, with the proof, when the task is completed, rejected or merged (since 0.11.0)

mergedInto.description: The task a proposal was merged into (it is then in the trash) (since 0.11.0)

clientId.description: clientId of the operation that created the task

overdue.description: Only in list_all, board and get_task
